text:
jamie: Quick FYI, I spotted a couple of dead shortlinks while updating the onboarding runbook. pinging @lisa and @devon who touched quickstart recently. https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/onboarding

devon: Thanks. Which links?

jamie: Top nav TOC points to /kb/quickstart#env-setup and /kb/quickstart#secrets but both 404 in staging. Also found /r/run-onboard -> 301 -> 404.

lisa: Ugh. That shortlink was probably left over after the slug rename. I can claim the quickstart page owner if that helps. :raised_hands: 

pat: Are these only in staging or hitting prod too? I remember a preview-only glitch before.

jamie: Staging-first, but the shortlink 301 shows up in prod logs occasionally. docs-bot: nightly-scan found 3 dead anchors under /runbooks/onboarding.

devon: I can open a tiny PR to update anchors and add a redirect. sed/generic ripgrep for local fixes: 

```
rg "\b/r/run-onboard\b" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i '' 's|/r/run-onboard|/runbooks/onboarding|g' {}
rg "#env-setup" -n || true
```

lisa: Jamise, can you paste the exact anchors that failed? I'll add canonical anchors and a shortlink redirect for a few months.

jamie: Sure: env-setup-2 and secrets-v2 6 (looks like a versioned-anchor collision).

devon: PR: https://git.internal.redwood.dev/redwood/docs/pulls/842 - updates anchors, adds redirect. CI flagged missing frontmatter owner on that page.

lisa: I'll add myself to frontmatter owner in the PR and include a one-line changelog.

pat: I'll spin up the staging preview once CI passes and sanity-check anchors. If preview is green, +1 to merge. :+1:

docs-bot: preview build 6150001550: redirect added, anchors fixed, frontmatter owner present. no link regressions detected.

jamie: Great. devon, when you merge please tag the PR with "owner:lisa" so the docs rotation picks it up.

devon: Will do. Waiting on pat to confirm preview.

lisa: Filing a follow-up ticket to sweep other /r/ shortlinks later this week. low effort audit.

pat: Preview looks clean. merging after I do a quick local smoke.

devon: merged and tagged owner:lisa  closing thread. :tada:
